questions.collect_preserve: May IPR keep operating the private collector and preserving originals from this listing?
questions.external_model_transmission: May the original Vietnamese text be sent to an external model provider (Anthropic) for translation and analysis?
questions.public_original_storage: May the Vietnamese original be stored in the public pla_watch.db and public Git history?
questions.public_full_translation: May IPR publish a complete machine English translation of each article?
questions.public_excerpt: May IPR publish short quotations, and up to how many characters?
questions.public_ipr_analysis: May IPR publish its own English summary and event classification of each article?
questions.public_title_display: May IPR show the original Vietnamese title with a link to the official page?

evidence_required: rights_basis_type: one of documented_administrative_document_assessment, documented_independent_source_use_assessment, explicit_official_reuse_terms, written_rights_owner_permission (a site footer or attribution line is not a basis)

rights_basis_reference: explicit official terms/permission, or for MPS/VPCP a dated source-specific independent source-use assessment in docs/engineering/ covering full-body Anthropic input, provenance, applicable law and its limits; the assessment is not a publisher license
attribution_text and any license_terms the basis imposes
robots_review_reference: the dated robots.txt / access review for vanban.chinhphu.vn and datafiles.chinhphu.vn
